briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.2%) with no clear risk-on signal, and available cash ($189.29) is well below the $500 threshold for a meaningful new position. Holding all 7 existing positions and waiting for a stronger setup before deploying remaining capital.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today's neutral market and low available cash meant there wasn't a compelling reason to force a new trade — patience preserves capital for a better setup rather than chasing mediocre entries.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是預留在場邊、待有良好機會時才動用的現金。今日市況中性，可動用現金亦不多，並無充分理由勉強開新倉——耐心等待更佳時機，比勉強進場更能保護資本。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%, reflecting a lack of strong directional conviction among investors rather than any major catalyst. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, trading stayed range-bound as market participants awaited fresh data or news to set the next direction. This kind of quiet, low-volatility session is common between major economic releases or earnings catalysts.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市略為下跌，納斯達克指數跌0.4%，標普500指數跌0.2%，反映投資者缺乏明確方向，並非受重大消息影響。由於未見明顯的風險偏好或避險訊號，市場保持窄幅波動，投資者靜待新數據或消息公布以確立下一步走勢。這種低波動的平靜交易日在重大經濟數據或業績公布之間頗為常見。
